name: get-feed-posts
description: Cloud Function que alimenta o feed

scripts.deploy-cloud-function: cd deploy && gcloud functions deploy getFeedPosts --gen2 --runtime nodejs22 --max-instances 10 --trigger-http --region southamerica-east1 --allow-unauthenticated --project ${GCP_PROJECT:-corresocialapp} --entry-point getFeedPosts --service-account fn-feed@${GCP_PROJECT:-corresocialapp}.iam.gserviceaccount.com

author: Wellington Souza
